title: List each Space's own Circle apart from regular Circles on /circles

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: a Space's built-in Circle is its member wall; list those separately so they do not overwhelm the regular Circles, which crew or Spaces may start

verify.evidence: Probe fails on main (no space kind, is_space_primary not read) and passes here; kind and shelf tests pass.

detail: circleKind gains a space kind: an owned Circle flagged is_space_primary (the built-in Space Circle, ADR-1391). The index reads the flag, the default view draws those on a Space Circles shelf after Business Circles, and the filtered view draws them in a section under Results. They no longer count toward Results, Near you, Gathering or Community. A Circle a Space started on purpose stays a regular Business Circle. Public /discover/circles and the Space pages are unchanged and still to do if wanted.
